issues: 页面是一眼占位的模板文案（The headline for / your product here、sample、@USERNAME、app.example.com）
H1 的标注 "H1 · SERIF DISPLAY" 直接压在右侧模块卡上，两块内容撞在一起
标注是 6.5px（成片约 26px）浅灰等宽字，类目与细项没有层级，小窗下读不清（Q11）
扫描线是一根白线配极淡的拖尾，扫过的区域与没扫过的区域没有任何区别，看不出"机器读过"
取景框是 6px 粗的方头白边，收拢后就定死，没有跟随动作；背景死平无暗角颗粒
changes: 页面换成可信的工作室官网 Arden Studio：带锁的地址栏、Type that moves / the way you speak 双行衬线标题、实心主按钮 + 幽灵链接、kinetic 样片卡与四格关键姿态缩略帧、真实页脚与社交账号
H1 标注挪到标题正下方（替掉页面里重复的字体注释），所有标注不再与相邻模块碰撞
标注升到 8px（成片 32px）：先亮一颗强调色定位点，再从左向右擦出文字并上移 3px，类目词亮、细项暗两级
扫描线改为白热光芯 + 冷蓝三层辉光、左右两端各 18% 渐隐，身后留一层 70px 内衰减的点阵网格余晖；修掉 mask 裁掉下侧辉光的问题
取景框角标改 1px 圆头细臂 + 微弱辉光，收拢后臂长 12→9px 再收一档（比框晚落定）；状态行下加扫描进度细条，背景加顶部冷光、暗角与颗粒
issuesEn: The page used obvious template copy (The headline for / your product here, sample, @USERNAME, app.example.com)
The H1 annotation "H1 · SERIF DISPLAY" sat right on top of the module card on the right, colliding with it
Annotations were 6.5px (about 26px on output) light-grey mono with no hierarchy between category and detail, unreadable in a small player (Q11)
The scanline was a single white line with a faint tail; scanned and unscanned areas looked identical, so nothing read as "the machine has read this"
Viewfinder corners were 6px square-capped white borders that froze once they closed, with no follow-through; the background was flat with no vignette or grain
changesEn: The page is now a believable studio site, Arden Studio: padlocked address pill, a two-line serif headline Type that moves / the way you speak, solid primary button plus ghost link, a kinetic sample card with four key-pose thumbnails, and a real footer and social handle
The H1 annotation moved directly under the headline (replacing the page's redundant font note), so no label collides with a neighbouring module
Annotations are 8px (32px on output): an accent locator dot lights first, then the text wipes in left to right while rising 3px, with a bright category word and a dimmer detail

The scanline has a white-hot core with three layers of cool-blue glow and 18% fades at both ends, leaving a dot-grid afterglow that decays within 70px; fixed a mask that was clipping the glow below the core

Corners are 1px round-capped arms with a faint glow whose arms tighten 12→9px after the frame closes (settling later than the frame); a scan progress hairline sits under the status line; top cool light, vignette and grain added to the background
